trailhead.label: The La Versina picnic area, Mattie, the board’s start

cautions: The mule track is very steep in places (T2): take it slowly with your dog and watch its footing on wet cobbles.
The upper part is inside the Orsiera-Rocciavrè park, where dogs must stay on a lead.
Cows may graze at Alpe Toglie in summer: keep your dog on a short lead near the herd.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
